questions.question: John is as intelligent as Tom. (Make it Comparative)

options.a: Tom is more intelligent than John.
options.b: John is not less intelligent than Tom.
options.c: John is less intelligent than Tom.
options.d:
Tom is not less intelligent than John.
**

questions.correct_answer_text: John is not less intelligent than Tom.
questions.explanation: Positive → Comparative: subject-object swap, affirmative→negative, degree changes. "John is not less intelligent than Tom" uses less+positive degree method.

questions.question: I made a mistake. (Make it interrogative)
questions.explanation: Assertive → Interrogative: use negative interrogative form. Past Indefinite → "Didn't" + base form.

questions.question: What an excellent idea! (Assertive)

options.b: It is a very excellent idea.
options.d:
It is a very good idea.
**

questions.correct_answer_text: It is a very excellent idea.
questions.explanation: Exclamatory → Assertive: Subject + verb + a/an + very/great + adjective + noun.

questions.question: Choose the simple form of the sentence 'Stand here and die'.

options.a: Stand here so that you can die
options.c: Without standing here you will die.
options.d:
As you stand here you will die
**

questions.explanation: Compound → Simple: the verb after "and" becomes infinitive (to + verb). "die" → "only to die".

questions.question: The negative form of the sentence 'Neela is taller than Bushra' is ___

options.b: Bushra is not taller than Neela.
options.c: Neela is not shorter than Bushra.
options.d:
Bushra is not so tall as Neela.
**

questions.correct_answer_text: Bushra is not so tall as Neela.
questions.explanation: Comparative → Negative: 2nd Subject + is not so + positive degree + as + 1st Subject. → "Bushra is not so tall as Neela."

questions.question: He must do it. (Make it Negative)

options.c: He must not, but do this.

questions.question: Our present house suits us. Make it complex.

options.a: The house which we live suits us.
options.b: The house is suitable where we live.
options.c: The house in which we live is suitable.
options.d:
The house in which we live at present suits us.
**

questions.correct_answer_text: The house in which we live at present suits us.
questions.explanation: Simple → Complex: introduce a relative clause. "present house" → "the house in which we live at present".

questions.question: Ten years have passed since his father died. Make it simple:

options.a: His father has died ten years ago.
options.b: His father died since ten years ago.
options.c: His father has died for ten years.
options.d:
His father died ten years ago.
**

questions.correct_answer_text: His father died ten years ago.
questions.explanation: Complex → Simple: "Ten years have passed since his father died" = "His father died ten years ago."

questions.question: It is more than honesty. (Make positive)

options.a: Honesty is not as much as it
options.b: Honesty are not as much as it
options.c: Honesty is as much as it
options.d:
Honesty is less much as it
**

questions.correct_answer_text: Honesty is not as much as it
questions.explanation: Comparative → Positive: swap subject/object, affirmative→negative, change degree. "more" → "as much as". → "Honesty is not as much as it."

questions.question: Joseph is as disciplined as Tom. (Comparative)

options.a: Tom is more disciplined than Joseph.
options.b: Joseph is not less disciplined than Tom.
options.c: Joseph is less disciplined than Tom.
options.d:
Tom is not less disciplined than Joseph.
**

questions.correct_answer_text: Joseph is not less disciplined than Tom.
questions.explanation: Positive → Comparative using "less": keep same subject, add "not less + positive degree + than + object".

questions.question: You must be submissive to the Almighty. (Make it Negative)

options.a: You cannot be submissive to the Almighty.
options.b: You cannot but being submissive to the Almighty.
options.c: You cannot but submissive to the Almighty.
options.d:
You cannot help being submissive to the Almighty.
**

questions.correct_answer_text: You cannot help being submissive to the Almighty.
questions.explanation: "must" → Negative: "cannot help + verb-ing" or "cannot but + base verb". Here "being submissive" → D is correct.
